title: The 'held back in the background' rest-alert row says 'Allow it' but opens the app's general Android page
what: When Android is holding MettleUp back in the background, Settings shows 'Rest alerts: May be late, tap to fix' with the line 'Android is holding MettleUp back in the background. Allow it'. The tap opens the app's general Android info page, not the battery or background page, and the words never say what to press there (Battery, then Unrestricted). Many members will look at the page, find nothing called 'Allow' and go back, and rest alerts stay late.
expected: The row names the exact steps on the page it opens (for example: tap Battery, then choose Unrestricted), or opens the battery page itself where the phone allows it.
who: members on Android whose phone restricts background apps
fix_line: Say the steps on that page (Battery, then Unrestricted) in the row, or open the battery page directly

title: A failed read during 'try a harder or easier version' says the exercise is not in your library
what: In a live workout, tapping the harder or easier version of an exercise first reads that exercise from the phone. If that read fails for any reason, the member is told 'Not in your library: <name> is not in your exercise library', which is a wrong fact: the exercise is there, the read just failed, and trying again could work.
expected: A failed read says it could not switch and to try again; 'not in your library' only when the exercise really is missing.
who: members switching to a harder or easier version
how_often: rare, only when the phone read fails
fix_line: Tell a failed read apart from a missing exercise and say Could not switch, try again
